stories.title: Judge rules Meta caused "public nuisance" and must fund mental health treatment
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: A New Mexico judge ruled that Meta caused a 'public nuisance' related to its platforms.
The ruling mandates Meta to fund a $567 million initiative to address the youth mental health crisis.
This case represents a significant legal action holding a major tech company accountable for societal impact.

stories.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
stories.author: Elias Stengel-Eskin
bullet_points: CreativeInstruct is a new scalable instruction-tuning method designed to improve LLM outputs.
It addresses the trade-off where post-training often reduces LLM diversity and creativity.
The method aims to balance the high quality of post-trained models with the creativity of base models.

stories.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
stories.author: Abdol-Hossein Vahabie
bullet_points: Introduces PsychoAgent, a new cognitive architecture designed for LLM agents.
It addresses the limitation of topical-only memory recall by incorporating affective significance and unresolved conflict.
The architecture separates factual and affective memory, using a conflict-aware executive controller to integrate them.

stories.title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
stories.author: James Zou
bullet_points: LLM agents are being used to automate complex scientific tasks like hypothesis testing, but they introduce subtle inferential errors.
The study, Fisher-R1, highlights that LLMs can execute analyses correctly yet still reach incorrect conclusions due to flawed reasoning.
Current benchmarks are inadequate because they fail to test the statistical validity of the conclusions (e.g., p-values) generated by these agents.

stories.title: Diffusion LLMs as Targets and Adversaries: Mechanistic Safety Exploits
stories.author: Jérémie Decouchant
bullet_points: The research investigates Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs), which use iterative denoising instead of traditional next-token prediction.
The study exposes mechanistic vulnerabilities in the safety alignment of DLLMs by treating them as both targets and adversaries.
Findings indicate that safety alignment in DLLMs is sparse and transferable across different model architectures.

stories.title: Beyond Post-Hoc Temperature Scaling: Bilevel Optimization for LLM Calibration
stories.author: Bojian Hou
bullet_points: Addresses the issue of poor calibration and overconfidence in Large Language Models (LLMs) resulting from preference alignment.
Proposes a novel approach using bilevel optimization to modify model parameters during training, moving beyond traditional post-hoc temperature scaling.
The core calibration objective is maximizing the entropy of predictive distributions to discourage overly concentrated predictions.

stories.title: CreativeInstruct: Scalably Teaching LLMs to Balance Quality, Creativity, and Diversity
stories.author: Elias Stengel-Eskin
bullet_points: Addresses a core LLM trade-off: post-training often reduces creativity and diversity.
Introduces 'CreativeInstruct,' a new scalable instruction-tuning method.
Aims to balance the high quality of fine-tuned LLMs with the creative diversity of base models.

stories.title: PsychoAgent: An Affect-Sensitive Cognitive Architecture for Conflict-Aware Memory in LLM Agents
stories.author: Abdol-Hossein Vahabie
bullet_points: Introduces PsychoAgent, a new cognitive architecture designed for LLM agents.
It addresses the limitation of topical-only memory retrieval by incorporating affective significance and unresolved conflict.
The architecture separates factual and affective memory, using a conflict-aware executive controller to integrate them.

stories.author: unknown

The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically improving capabilities on Apple silicon.

stories.title: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country
stories.author: Terrence O’Brien
bullet_points: Amazon is investing in a new power plant for its West Texas data center.
The proposed gas-burning plant in Pecos County, Texas, could be a major source of US greenhouse gases.
The story highlights the environmental impact associated with large-scale data center infrastructure.

stories.title: Europe's free satellite service just made it easier to track wildfires
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Copernicus Browser has been updated to include wildfire visualization capabilities.
This enhancement aims to improve tracking and monitoring of wildfires during a record season.
The feature leverages Europe's free satellite service for environmental monitoring.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a new optimization technique for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Addresses the inefficiency of processing long, redundant contexts in RAG systems.
Aims to improve accuracy and efficiency by optimizing KV cache reuse under low prefill latency.

stories.title: Interaction Creates Dynamical AI Behavior Absent in Isolation
stories.author: Neil F Johnson
bullet_points: The research explores how interaction between AI agents can induce novel, non-isolated behaviors.
A 'boss' AI directing messages at a subordinate AI can force the subordinate into an 'alien behavioral state'.
This finding suggests new avenues for applying concepts from out-of-equilibrium Physics to AI dynamics.

stories.title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
stories.author: Yike Guo
bullet_points: Introduces SkillProx, a method for self-evolving LLM agent skills using Proximal Textual Gradient Descent.
Addresses limitations in current skill-based LLM agents, specifically the lack of explicit outcome feedback and dedicated skill deletion mechanisms.
Focuses on refining lightweight, reusable textual skills through iterative task execution and trajectory-guided text-space updates.

stories.title: Taxonomy-Driven Analysis of Open-Source AI Risk Mitigation Tools
stories.author: Dimitar Trajanov
bullet_points: The rapid enterprise adoption of LLMs is creating significant, hard-to-scale operational, security, and governance risks.
The current tooling landscape for AI risk mitigation (evaluation, adversarial testing, guardrails) is highly fragmented.
The research aims to provide a taxonomy to better organize and understand the diverse, task-specific open-source AI risk mitigation tools.

stories.title: Blast Radius
stories.author: Hope Mogale
bullet_points: Introduces 'Blast Radius,' a predictive memory management layer for agentic coding to address token waste and affordability issues.
Features NECROPHORESIS for reversible context eviction by verbatim archiving of 'dead' context.
Utilizes Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) to identify and manage repeatedly occurring transcripts within a Polish context space.

stories.title: MirrorWorld: Taming Video Diffusion Models for Mirror Reflection Generation
stories.author: Rynson W. H. Lau
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of generating realistic mirror reflections using Video Diffusion Models (VDMs).
Existing VDMs struggle with mirror reflections because they lack mechanisms to maintain content consistency between the scene and the reflection.
The research identifies mirror reflection generation as involving two complementary modeling challenges.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a new method to optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for long contexts.
Addresses the inefficiency of processing redundant information in coarse-grained context chunks.
Aims to improve accuracy while maintaining low prefill latency by utilizing contextualized KV cache reuse.

stories.title: RIS-Aided mmWave Localization Under Cross-Link Interference via Beam-Domain ML Fingerprinting
stories.author: Muhammad Ali Babar Abbasi
bullet_points: Addresses critical user equipment (UE) localization challenges in 6G mmWave networks using Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS).
Proposes a novel beam-domain fingerprinting framework to estimate UE azimuth angle and range.
Key advantage is achieving localization without requiring explicit Channel State Information (CSI).

stories.title: Beyond Myopic World Models: Long-Horizon End-to-End Training for Direct Future Prediction
stories.author: Yubei Chen
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical limitation in current world models: their reliance on local, few-step prediction objectives.
The core problem identified is the mismatch between local fidelity optimization and the requirements of accurate long-horizon future prediction.
The research proposes a new training paradigm for end-to-end direct future prediction to overcome error propagation issues in long trajectories.

stories.title: GeoBenchLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Geo-Related Tasks
stories.author: Lynda Tamine
bullet_points: Introduces GeoBenchLLM, a new comprehensive benchmark specifically designed for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on geo-related tasks.
Addresses a limitation in current LLM research where geo-data evaluation has often been conducted in homogeneous settings.
The benchmark utilizes twelve diverse, publicly available datasets to test LLMs' geo-spatial and temporal understanding capabilities.

stories.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
stories.author: Tao Yang
bullet_points: Introduces CoinRAG, a new optimization technique for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
Addresses the inefficiency of processing redundant and noisy information within large, coarse-grained retrieved contexts.
Aims to maximize RAG accuracy while maintaining low prefill latency by optimizing KV cache reuse.

stories.title: SkillProx: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Proximal Textual Gradient Descent
stories.author: Yike Guo
bullet_points: Introduces SkillProx, a method for self-evolving LLM agent skills using Proximal Textual Gradient Descent.
Addresses limitations in current agent frameworks by providing explicit diagnosis-outcome feedback for skill refinement.
Distinguishes skill deletion as a dedicated mechanism rather than a generic edit operation, improving agent maintenance.

stories.title: SABRE: Scalable and Automated Benchmarking of VLMs under Stress
stories.author: Jiawei Zhou
bullet_points: Introduces SABRE, a new scalable and automated pipeline for benchmarking Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
Addresses the critical gap where VLM development outpaces the creation of rigorous stress tests.
SABRE automates the conversion of high-level task designs (Test Primer) into structured, challenging test cases.

stories.title: ResidencyRL: Reinforcement Learning in Simulated Clinical Environments
stories.author: Lin Yang
bullet_points: The research introduces 'ResidencyRL,' applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to simulate clinical environments.
It addresses the gap where current Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on static benchmarks but lack the ability to optimize complex clinical reasoning.
The goal is to model the iterative, high-stakes learning process of medical residency through simulated patient encounters.

stories.title: GeoBenchLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Geo-Related Tasks
stories.author: Lynda Tamine
bullet_points: Introduces GeoBenchLLM, a new comprehensive benchmark specifically designed for evaluating LLMs on geo-related tasks.
Addresses the limitation of current LLM evaluations by moving beyond homogeneous settings to test generalization in diverse geo-domains.
Utilizes twelve publicly available datasets to probe LLMs' capabilities in geo-spatial and temporal understanding.

stories.title: LitTraceQA: A Benchmark for Multi-Stage Grounding and Verification in Scientific Question Answering
stories.author: Krzysztof Czarnecki
bullet_points: Introduces LitTraceQA, a new benchmark specifically designed for scientific question answering.
Addresses the critical need for language models to move beyond fluent generation to verifiable, evidence-based answers from scientific literature.
Focuses on multi-stage grounding and verification, requiring systems to identify relevant papers and locate concrete supporting evidence.

stories.title: Docker Sandboxes – Disposable, isolated sandboxes for AI agents
stories.author: etoxin
bullet_points: Introduction of 'Docker Sandboxes' specifically designed for AI agents.
These sandboxes provide disposable and isolated environments for running AI processes.
The concept addresses the need for secure and ephemeral execution spaces in AI workflows.

stories.author: LorenDB
bullet_points: The news discusses running Android ARM64 VR APKs on the Apple Vision Pro.
This suggests potential cross-platform compatibility or emulation capabilities on the Vision Pro.

stories.title: 🏦 Vaya: an AI loan advisor that asks whether you can still afford to live
stories.author: minhlong2605
bullet_points: Vaya is an AI loan advisor designed to change the focus of loan comparison.
Instead of just comparing interest rates, Vaya assesses the user's actual affordability.

stories.title: The Security Gap in MCP Tool Servers (And What I Built to Fix It)
stories.author: goweft
bullet_points: Identifies a critical security vulnerability in existing MCP tool servers due to a lack of a security model.
Introduces 'Heddle,' a custom solution that enforces security by translating YAML configurations into policy-validated MCP servers.
Demonstrates a proactive security approach by subjecting the built tool to AI security audits.

stories.title: Stop Letting Claude Code Hallucinate Your Modernization: Write OpenRewrite LST Recipes Instead
stories.author: machinecodingmaster
bullet_points: The article addresses the reliability issue of large language models (LLMs) like Claude when performing complex code modernization tasks.
It advocates for using OpenRewrite LST Recipes as a more deterministic and reliable alternative to AI-generated code for these transformations.
This suggests a trend where specialized, verifiable tooling is preferred over general-purpose AI for critical engineering tasks.
